summary: Official Obsidian agent skills that teach Claude, ChatGPT and other agents to work with Obsidian Markdown, Bases, Canvas and vaults.

heroCommands.command:
claude plugin marketplace add obsidianmd/obsidian-skills
claude plugin install obsidian@obsidian-skills

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Obsidian Skills is the official set of agent skills from the Obsidian team. They teach AI agents to create and edit Obsidian notes, Bases and JSON Canvas files correctly, use the Obsidian CLI, and work with open formats like Markdown.
sixtySeconds.problem: AI agents often break Obsidian-specific syntax such as wikilinks, embeds and Bases formulas. These skills give the agent the exact formats and tools, so edits to your vault come out right.
whoFor: Obsidian users who work with AI agents
Claude Code and Codex users with notes in Obsidian
People who sync or publish vaults from the command line
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for official, standards-based skills that work across many agents, from Claude and ChatGPT to Cursor, Copilot and Gemini CLI.

overview: Skills include obsidian-markdown (Obsidian Flavored Markdown), obsidian-bases (Bases views, filters and formulas), json-canvas (Canvas files), obsidian-cli (vault and plugin work through the Obsidian CLI), obsidian-headless (sync and publish without the app), defuddle (clean Markdown from web pages) and knap (templates from JSON or CSV).

Obsidian is listed as an official plugin for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and others. For Claude Code, add the marketplace and install the plugin; other agents can install with npx skills or by copying the skill folders.
The skills follow the Agent Skills specification and are MIT licensed.
